answer: Sybil resistance uses a jetty of sequential memory-hard proofs docked at a public wharf of prior commitments. Each extra identity must extend the jetty by solving a karst of uneven, non-parallelizable probes costing 15 serial minutes and 200 tokens of locked stake. Matching probe fingerprints across the jetty trigger a slash of 40 times the square of the cluster size. Honest agents pay one extension; a farm of 25 faces either 25 times the serial compute or a 25000-token correlated slash. Verify by replaying the wharf log for equality checks.
